Export a Structured Apptainer Recipe Descriptor for HPC Orchestrators

Source: R/handoff.R
as_apptainer_spec.Rd

Converts an rcapsule_scan, rcapsule_apptainer, rcapsule_bundle, or project directory path into a self-contained, plain-list-convertible Apptainer specification descriptor (rcapsule_apptainer_spec). Designed as a zero-dependency handoff contract for downstream HPC job orchestrators (such as Slurm array/container runners) that need pinned base images, environment variables, HPC bind mounts, runscript commands, and the SHA-256 digest of the .def recipe without coupling to rcapsule internals.

Usage

as_apptainer_spec(
  x,
  base_image = NULL,
  r_version = NULL,
  base_digest = NULL,
  cran_repo = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2026-01-15",
  quarto_version = "1.5.57",
  cmdstan_version = "2.35.0",
  workdir = "/capsule",
  entrypoint = NULL,
  bind_paths = c("/scratch", "/work", "/data"),
  output = NULL,
  allow_unpinned = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

An rcapsule_scan, rcapsule_apptainer, rcapsule_bundle, or path to a project directory.

base_image

Optional pinned Docker base image override forwarded to compile_apptainer().

r_version

Optional R version string override.

base_digest

Optional SHA-256 image digest appended to base_image.

cran_repo

Pinned CRAN or Posit Package Manager repository URL.

quarto_version

Pinned Quarto CLI version when Quarto is detected.

cmdstan_version

Pinned CmdStan version when CmdStan is detected.

workdir

Project directory inside the container image. Defaults to "/capsule".

entrypoint

Optional override for the %runscript entrypoint.

bind_paths

Character vector of absolute HPC bind mount paths (default c("/scratch", "/work", "/data")).

output

Optional file path to write the compiled .def recipe when compiling or overriding settings.

allow_unpinned

Logical; if FALSE (default), rejects :latest or untagged base images.

Value

An S3 object of class c("rcapsule_apptainer_spec", "rcapsule") (convertible to a plain list via as.list()) with fields schema_version, project_name, project_type, r_version, bootstrap, base_image, workdir, entrypoint, r_packages, apt_packages, python_packages, toolchains, env_vars, bind_paths, binds, runscript, test_commands, def_content, def_sha256, content_digest, def_path, and sif_path.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_hpc_spec_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines(c("library(jsonlite)", "cat('ok\\n')"), file.path(tmp, "run.R"))
spec <- as_apptainer_spec(tmp)
spec
#> 
#> ── rcapsule Apptainer Spec Descriptor: rcapsule_hpc_spec_18be190505b4 ──────────
#> • Base image: "rocker/r-ver:4.6.2" (Bootstrap: docker)
#> • Project type: "analysis" | R: "4.6.2" | Workdir: /capsule
#> • Entrypoint: "run.R"
#> • Dependencies: 1 R pkg(s), 1 apt pkg(s), 0 Python pkg(s)
#> • Toolchains: standard R
#> • HPC bind paths: /scratch, /work, /data
#> • Recipe SHA-256: "1badce64f73d9d64"...
names(as.list(spec))
#>  [1] "schema_version"  "project_name"    "project_type"    "r_version"      
#>  [5] "bootstrap"       "base_image"      "workdir"         "entrypoint"     
#>  [9] "r_packages"      "apt_packages"    "python_packages" "toolchains"     
#> [13] "env_vars"        "bind_paths"      "binds"           "runscript"      
#> [17] "test_commands"   "def_content"     "def_sha256"      "content_digest" 
#> [21] "def_path"        "sif_path"       
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
